items.title: AI coding agents still need human cleanup on nearly three out of four tasks in a real-world test
items.snippet:
Alibaba's new coding-agent benchmark, Co-Design Bench, tests AI agents on real user requests that already tripped them up in practice. Even GPT-6 Astra, the top performer, fully solves only 26.4 percent of tasks. On older benchmarks, the same models score above 99 percent. 
 The article  AI coding agents still need human cleanup on nearly three out of four tasks in a real-world test  appeared first on  The Decoder .
